_comment: Macro governance allowlist, consumed by tools/check_macro_governance.py at
CMake configure time. A macro is a scope escape: it ignores namespaces,
types and overloads, and it is invisible to every tool that is not a
preprocessor. So one is not added by accident -- it is added here, on
purpose, with the reason recorded next to it.
allowed_macros      -- may be #defined in the repository.
banned_macros       -- may NOT be expanded (used), anywhere.
third_party_families -- prefixes that are expected to appear as
expansions because they come from extern/.
Documented for the full (libclang) pass, which
is the only pass that can tell a macro apart
